entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit customer support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hi, I... I think I need to make a return? I'm not really sure how this works.
Hello, you've reached VeloFit! My name is Sarah. I can definitely help you with that. What item were you calling about today?
It's the new helmet I bought. I just got it a few days ago, I think.
Okay, I can look into that for you. What specifically is the issue with the helmet? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
Oh, no, it's not broken. The box is still unopened. It's just the color. On the website it looked so different. I'm all confused. It doesn't match my gear at all. Can't you just help me?

I completely understand, sometimes the on-screen color can be a little deceiving. And I can absolutely help you. Since you received the helmet just five days ago, you are well within our 90-day return policy for apparel and gear.
Oh, really? 90 days? That's a relief. I was worried I'd be stuck with it. I just want to make sure I have the right equipment for my safety, and that I feel good wearing it, you know?

Of course. Your comfort and safety are most important. I've just emailed a pre-paid return shipping label to the address on your file. All you need to do is print it out, place it on the original box, and drop it off at the post office. Once our warehouse receives it, we'll process a full refund.
Wow, that's it? That's so easy. Thank you so much, Sarah. You've been a huge help.
You're very welcome! Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that was everything. Thanks again!
It was my pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
